command.open.title: Regex Tester
panel.main.title: Regex Tester
surface.title: Regex Tester
surface.subtitle: Pattern, flags and sample text
surface.samplePlaceholder: Paste or type text to test
surface.noMatchesHint: Adjust the expression, flags, or sample text.
surface.enterPatternHint: Enter an expression above to begin.
surface.extractHint: Extract all whole matches (up to {limit}), joined with new lines. Keeps order, duplicates and whitespace. Highlighting only locates a match.
surface.emptyMatches: All matches are zero-length. There is no matched text to extract.
error.continueFailed: Could not return to Launcher. Your text and matches are still here. Try again.
error.invalid: Invalid pattern or flags. Check the expression and try again.
execution.timeout: Execution stopped after 1 second. Your input is kept. Edit the expression or text to try again.
execution.failed: Could not start the regex worker. Your input is kept; edit to retry.
execution.cancelled: Execution cancelled. Edit the expression or text to try again.
ai.title: Generate a candidate with AI
ai.disclosure: Uses your configured AI provider and model. Sends only the description and examples below when you click Generate. Examples: one literal string per line; positive means at least one match, negative means none.
ai.settingsFailed: Could not open AI settings. Your input is kept.
ai.status.generating: Generating… Your current expression is kept.
ai.status.validating: Checking the complete candidate in a bounded worker…
ai.status.ready: Candidate passed the supplied examples. Review before adopting; this is not a guarantee for other text.
ai.status.cancelled: Cancelled. Your input is kept; you can generate again.
ai.failure.blocked: Configured AI is not ready. Check the provider, login and model in AI settings, then retry.
ai.failure.limits: Use a description of 1–4,000 characters and at most 12 examples, each up to 4,000 characters. Nothing was sent.
ai.failure.model: The AI request did not finish successfully. Your input is kept; try again.
ai.failure.response: The response was incomplete or was not a valid pattern/flags JSON candidate. Your expression is kept.
ai.failure.timeout: Generation or validation exceeded its time limit. Your input is kept; simplify and retry.
ai.failure.invalid: The candidate could not be compiled or checked in the worker. Your expression is kept.
ai.failure.validation: Some examples failed. This candidate cannot be adopted. Adjust the description or examples and generate again.
ai.failure.changed: The AI configuration changed. Generate again using the current configuration.
extraction.missing-group: Some matches do not contain the selected capture. Nothing was extracted. Edit the expression or choose another group.
extraction.empty-group: The selected capture contains an empty string, which cannot be represented unambiguously as a line list. Nothing was extracted. Edit the expression or choose another group.
extraction.truncated: More than {limit} matches; only part of the result is shown. Nothing was extracted. Narrow the input or expression.
extraction.too-large: Extraction exceeds 1 MiB. Nothing was extracted. Narrow the input.
